artist.name: ROSIE
artist.short_description: ROSIE: an Afterglow editorial discovery candidate in emotional pop.
artist.biography: ROSIE is an American singer-songwriter from the New York area whose work centers on personal writing and emotionally direct pop. Her official biography identifies “Never the 1” as a breakthrough single and documents her signing to Arista Records and the release of her debut EP, 20mg of Happiness, in 2021. The project addresses the stages of grief after a breakup, a framing she also discussed publicly around its release. A second EP, 5 Songs for Healing, followed in 2023; Sony Music published information about its release and track list. She has also collaborated with Caleb Hearn on “Little Bit Better,” a song released through Nettwerk in 2024, and toured with Chelsea Cutler. For Afterglow, she is a strong bridge between intimate singer-songwriter material and contemporary emotional pop. The themes and similarity descriptions used on the site should be explicitly treated as Afterglow editorial classifications, except when backed by specific firsthand statements. Her identity should remain distinct from Rosie Darling, who is a separate musician already in the catalogue.
